title: Continuing Lateness Charge on Assisted Living Late Fees
content:
**Clause of the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement on continuing lateness.**

Continuing lateness adds to the late fee. The days past grace are the calendar days from the posting date of the monthly charges to the handling date, less the 10 grace days.

- **More than 15 days past grace:** 2.00 dollars are added for each day beyond 15.
- **More than 7 and no more than 15 days past grace:** a single 10.00 dollar charge is added.
- **7 or fewer days past grace:** nothing is added.

The continuing-lateness charge is added to the greater-of amount (the greater of the flat late fee and the percentage of the past-due amount); the two together make up the late fee, which is rounded once to the cent at the end.

### Both sides of each threshold (monthly charges posted on a hypothetical 1 March)

| Handling date | Days from posting | Days past grace | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 14 | 4 | Nothing |
| 18 March | 17 | 7 | Nothing |
| 19 March | 18 | 8 | 10.00 |
| 26 March | 25 | 15 | 10.00 |
| 27 March | 26 | 16 | 2.00 (1 day beyond 15) |
| 1 April | 31 | 21 | 12.00 (6 days beyond 15) |

Illustration: a greater-of amount of 99.36 with 21 days past grace makes a late fee of 99.36 plus 12.00, that is 111.36.
